title: Character of gains — Alvarez Machine Shop
instructions: Luis Alvarez operates a machine shop as a sole proprietorship. In 2025 he sold the assets below (all business assets held more than one year unless stated). He had no §1231 losses in prior years. Enter losses as negative numbers.

exhibits.title: 2025 sales
exhibits.content:
| Asset | Cost | Accumulated depreciation | Sale price |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Lathe | 90,000 | 50,000 | 70,000 |
| Drill press | 40,000 | 25,000 | 10,000 |
| Shop building (straight-line) | 300,000 | 60,000 | 330,000 |
| Land under a former parking lot | 100,000 | — | 120,000 |

Personal investments: stock held 3 years sold at a $12,000 gain; stock held 6 months sold at a $7,000 loss.

rows.label: Ordinary income (§1245) on the lathe
rows.explanation: Gain = 70,000 − 40,000 = 30,000, all recaptured (depreciation 50,000 exceeds the gain).

rows.label: Total gain on the building
rows.explanation: 330,000 − 240,000 = **90,000** (all §1231; no ordinary recapture for an individual using straight-line).

rows.label: Unrecaptured §1250 gain on the building
rows.explanation: Lesser of the 90,000 gain or 60,000 depreciation = **60,000** (taxed at up to 25%).

rows.label: Net §1231 gain
rows.explanation: 90,000 + 20,000 (land) − 5,000 (drill press) = **105,000**, treated as long-term capital gain.

rows.label: Net capital gain for the year
Loss on the drill press
rows.explanation: A loss on business property held more than one year; it nets with other §1231 items.
